_comment: Optional plugins the Desktop Mode installer offers (none ticked). Each id is a plugin in the registry (mazillka/deckyhub-registry), picked by hand. "tag" (optional) is the part of a release tag to follow, for a repo with several release streams. Texts are plain words and may only use letters, digits, spaces and . , ; : ( ) / + - (build_installer.py checks it). "category" is the registry's category; the checklist lists plugins grouped by it, in this order.
